n, m, s, t = map(int, input().split())
s -= 1
t = int(t)

while t % n != 0:
    if s < m:
        s = (s + t) % n
    else:
        s = (s - t) % n
    t -= 1

t //= n
seen = [-1] * n
seen[s] = 0
count = 0

while t > 0:
    count += 1
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        if s < m:
            s = (s + i) % n
        else:
            s = (s - i) % n
    if seen[s] != -1:
        t %= (count - seen[s])
    seen[s] = count
    t -= 1

print(s + 1)
